title: A Weather for the Undertow
author: Odile Okonkwo
blurb: Bram Marchetti, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
